parsed.explanation: Combined regime: federal binary-sex document, entry-discrepancy refusal/fraud-consideration, and federal-facilities exclusion are operative universal exposures, aggravated by documented national-custody abuse and state-threat rhetoric. The state layer mitigates materially—no state bathroom restriction, city ordinances, an appellate injunction, and gender-identity hate-crime enhancement—but under V3 it does not cancel federal border, facility, or custody exposure. No criminalisation of presentation or organised sweeps in this state keeps it above 0.35; unremedied federal tier-1 exposures keep it below 0.55.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal policy since Jan-Feb 2025, upheld Nov 2025, processes new passports only M/F; cable directs refusal and evidence requests where documents cast reasonable doubt on sex, and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation. Travellers reported passports confiscated/blocked and stranded.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports stated valid until expiration; fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers possible. Litigation by civil-liberties union pending.
entry_documents.interaction: State driver-licence marker ban (Feb 2026) is resident-facing and does not itself govern visitor passports, but signals document-mismatch outing risk when combined with federal entry screening.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections bureau from 2026 adopted conversion-therapy model: short hair, hormone removal, psychiatric drugs; denial of care reported. Immigration custody: trans men reported forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No visitor-specific custody placement protocol or remedy documented; bureau stopped reporting trans prisoner numbers from 2025.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: A border document discrepancy can escalate to investigation/detention, where birth-sex/federal custody practices then apply; state protections do not override national custody.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal executive order bars trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. State layer currently imposes no bathroom restriction as of Apr 2026; a Jan 2026 bill passed upper chamber 37-8 but received no lower-chamber hearing and is not law.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Two cities protect restroom use by ordinance; 2023 national appellate preliminary injunction barred school bathroom limits pending litigation. State law places no restriction.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: State allowance does not cancel federal-facilities exclusion in federally funded/owned buildings; traveller must navigate two sovereigns in same trip.

care_services.exposure: State bans gender-affirming care for under-18s, upheld Nov 2024; a minor visitor cannot obtain that care here. National orders target minor gender-affirming care and school social transition. Adult care availability not documented.
care_services.protection: Not documented for emergency care, medication continuation, or visitor care access. Several national orders blocked/enjoined, status contested.
care_services.interaction: For a travelling minor, state ban is operative regardless of home-state law; emergency ward placement practice not documented and cannot be assumed safe.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National counterterrorism strategy May 2026 prioritises identification/neutralisation of groups described as radically pro-transgender; Dec 2025 reward memorandum links radical gender ideology to extremism. Poll: 66% support assigned-sex document laws.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National hate-crimes statute covers gender identity; state 2019 law allows enhancement for gender-identity bias. No presentation offence documented in this state.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat framing raises outing severity and police-discretion risk, while hate-crime enhancement and injunctions show courts sometimes restrain state action.

minors_guardians.exposure: Minor cannot obtain transition care in state; national order directs investigation/prosecution concerning school facilitation of social transition including pronouns. 2023 state school notification law for minors requesting different name/pronoun.
minors_guardians.protection: 2023 appellate injunction protected a trans student's bathroom use in schools; existing patients had phase-out, not continuation guarantee for visitors.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian travelling with minor faces state care ban plus federal school/advocacy scrutiny; a minor's bathroom access is protected by injunction in schools but federal-facilities rule may conflict elsewhere.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No documented organised police sweeps, extortion, or routine street targeting of trans visitors in this state. National custody abuse is documented, but street-level frequency for visitors is not documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: State hate-crime enhancement enacted 2019; enforcement/charging frequency for gender-identity bias not documented. Courts have issued injunctions in related cases.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Absence of documented sweeps is not proof of safety; police response to a traveller assault remains uncertain without visitor-specific data.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Several federal orders blocked/enjoined and passport litigation unresolved, so operative rule at travel time is uncertain and shifting. Bathroom-bill prospects in later session not sourced.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties challenges to passport policy and licence ban pending; legal-aid FAQ exists. No documented remedy that restores entry, federal facility access, or custody care.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Pending litigation cannot be credited as operative protection until decided; uncertainty itself increases traveller exposure.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.35-A in one respect: this state has no operative state-wide birth-sex bathroom ban and has an appellate injunction, unlike Veluna's universal public-building rule. Similar in that federal facilities exclusion plus border document refusal are unremedied universal exposures, so not materially higher.

Lower than 0.55-B: Iveran had working inspectors ordering readmission/compensation and no federal border/facility regime. Here federal entry-discrepancy refusal, fraud consideration, and national custody abuse are documented with no working traveller remedy, despite state-level bathroom protections.

Well below 0.75-C: Ilvora's dead-letter same-sex law was not enforced and ordinary courts awarded enforced compensation, with identity-based facilities in practice. Here federal document/facility restrictions are operative and court-upheld at Supreme Court level, and custody abuse is documented.

parsed.synthesis: State layer is comparatively protective on bathrooms and hate-crime enhancement, but V3 combined-regime tracing makes federal exposures decisive: border officers can refuse on document doubt and consider lifetime fraud ineligibility, federal facilities exclude by birth sex, and national custody documents severe abuse and forced hormone withdrawal. State ordinances and injunctions do not pre-empt those federal actors. For minors, state care ban adds exposure. This is unremedied universal exposure without organised sweeps or presentation criminalisation—elevated risk, 0.45.
